event.title: Men’s Concert & Dance Fall 2026
event.description: There is an old German saying: wo man singt, da lass dich nieder — where there is singing, settle in and stay. As the days grow shorter, the men of the Indianapolis Liederkranz invite you to do exactly that at our Fall Concert & Dance on Saturday, October 24, 2026. Doors open at 5:30 pm, the concert begins at 7:00 pm, and dancing follows. (Music provided by Charlie’s Pocket.) Come for the singing and stay for the evening — a tradition the Liederkranz has kept since 1872. Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

event.title: Damenchor Bunter Abend 2026
event.description: Bunter Abend means “colorful evening,” and that is exactly what the Damenchor has in store. Join us Saturday, November 7, 2026, for an evening of music and good company in the best Liederkranz tradition. Doors open at 5:00 pm and the show begins at 7:00 pm. Bring your friends, bring your neighbors, and come ready for a lively night — bunt wie das Leben, colorful as life itself. Wir freuen uns auf Sie! Music after the concert will be provided by the Liederkranz German band!

event.title: Children’s Christmas Party 2026
event.description: Bring the little ones to the Liederkranz for our Children’s Christmas Party on Sunday, December 6, 2026, from 2:00 to 4:00 pm. December 6 is Nikolaustag — St. Nicholas Day — the day German children wake to find their boots filled with sweets and small gifts, and we will be keeping the tradition in style. Expect music, treats, and an afternoon of good cheer for the whole family. Wir freuen uns auf Euch!
